message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# document:
# + https://docs.github.com/en/actions/automating-builds-and-tests/building-and-testing-swift
# + https://github.com/actions/virtual-environments/issues/4060
# + https://github.com/actions/virtual-environments

name: CI

on:
    push:
        branches:
            - main
    pull_request:
        branches:
            - main

jobs:
    test:
        runs-on: macos-11
        timeout-minutes: 30

        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v2

            - name: Cache Swift packages
              uses: actions/cache@v4
              with:
                path: ~/.swiftpm
                key: ${{ runner.os }}-swiftpm-${{ hashFiles('Package.resolved') }}
                restore-keys: |
                  ${{ runner.os }}-swiftpm-

            - name: Build Package
              run: swift build -v

            - name: Run tests
              run: swift test -v
",
  "rationale": "Added a job-level timeout (30 minutes) to prevent runaway builds, supported by experiment evidence showing 26.8% elapsed time savings when bounding job duration (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT). Added a dependency caching step for Swift Package Manager using actions/cache@v4 keyed on Package.resolved, supported by experiment evidence demonstrating cache usage for dependency downloads (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE / P-LIT-GHA-CACHE). Both changes preserve existing build and test coverage, require no new permissions, and avoid unrelated modifications.",
  "evidence_ids": [
    "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508",
    "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"
  ]
}

# + https://github.com/actions/virtual-environments/issues/4060
# + https://github.com/actions/virtual-environments

name: CI

on:
    push:
        branches:
            - main
    pull_request:
        branches:
            - main

jobs:
    test:
        runs-on: macos-11
        timeout-minutes: 30

        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v2

            - name: Cache Swift packages
              uses: actions/cache@v4

                key: ${{ runner.os }}-swiftpm-${{ hashFiles('Package.resolved') }}

            - name: Build Package
              run: swift build -v

            - name: Run tests
